messages.subject: Re: application has failed to start,
parts:
Hi Jeniffer,

You should be able to do most of these as a non-root user:

- Version of Shiny Server Pro:  Run "shiny-server --version" command
- Linux distribution and version: Run "cat /etc/issue" command

You might have different versions of Shiny package installed. You can run this command: R -e "packageVersion('shiny')"

Or if you have sudo access, run this instead:
 sudo su - -c "R -e \"packageVersion('shiny')\""

- Error you see in the browser: Just what browser page is showing when problem happens

- Error in browser console: Depending on the browser you should be able to open the JavScript Console or Browser Console from Tools menu

- Error in the application log file: This file is located in /var/log/shiny-server directory, and the name starts with your application's name. But it is restricted to "shiny" user (or the user which you have run the application as). You might need sudo access to read this file.

- Error in Shiny Server log file: File is /var/log/shiny-server.log. Look for any error towards the end of the file

- If you don't mind, link to the url on shinyapps.io

- Is it exactly the same code that runs on shinyapps.io and your own Shiny Server?
